text: That we are looking at, through this example. Okay. Now the scenario that we are looking at is the one, where we have an access point. And user Wi-Fi cards, that are connected. With this access point, so clearly they have made the three steps: scanning, identification, association, right? So they are connected with the access point. And we are also making this additional assumption that. All our nodes can hear each other, because there are no obstacles, nasty obstacles. All of them can hear each other. So even if of course each user Wi-Fi card, whenever it has got a packet to transmit, the packet necessarily needs to be sent to the access point, right? Because in this network architecture with access point, remember we said that user nodes can only communicate with the access point. They cannot communicate with each other. They communicate with each other only in ad hoc mode. Here we are with access point. The only possibility is to communicate with the access point for a user. However, as we know, the air is something where anybody can send a signal, right? So if this user, let's call it B, transmits something.
